The `sha256sums` entries are all `SKIP`, which is required for VCS sources and is ordinary practice — it is a hygiene choice, not malware. No `git pull`/`git fetch` of untrusted mutable content occurs in prepare or build. No genuinely malicious or injected behavior is present.
